• **Cannes Film Festival**

 
 
• The Cannes Film Festival, also known as Festival de Cannes, is one of the most prestigious and influential film festivals in the world.
 
• It is held annually in Cannes, France, showcasing new films of all genres, including documentaries, from around the world.
 
• The festival was founded in 1946 and has become a significant platform for filmmakers to present their work to an international audience.
 
• Awards such as the Palme d'Or are given to the best films, making it a highly coveted prize in the film industry.
 
 
 
• **Radhika Apte's Career**
 
 
• Radhika Apte is an Indian actress who has worked in Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, and English-language films.
 
• She began her acting career in theater before transitioning to films, gaining fame for her roles in movies like "Badlapur," "Phobia," "Andhadhun," and "Pad Man."
 
• Radhika has also appeared in several web series, including "Sacred Games" and "Ghoul," which have contributed to her international recognition.
 
• Her ability to portray complex characters and her dedication to her craft have earned her numerous accolades and a loyal fan base.
